newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish broker starts dollar loans for stock buys.
newsitem.headline: Polish broker starts dollar loans for stock buys.

text.p: Krajowy Dom Maklerski Passa is the first Polish brokerage to start issuing foreign currency loans for the purchase of stock, Passa's head of secondary market operations said on Friday.
"We're the first brokerage (in Poland) to offer foreign currency loans," Martyna Kulinska told Reuters.
In an agreement with Bank Wschodnio-Europejski SA, the brokerage offers six-month loans from $5,000 to $200,000 with an annual interest rate of 9.4 percent.
Passa's President Grzegorz Leszczynski told the financial daily Parkiet that demand for such loans could increase. @
"I think that over the next two months investors will urge the majority of brokerage houses to offer foreign currency loans," Parkiet quoted Leszczynski as saying.
